t: Forge Steel 90° mitre corner clamp constructed from durable aluminium alloy enables precise assembly and fabrication in tasks such as woodworking, metalworking, or general construction tasks. Features a a clamping force of up to 1200N and a flexi-head, enabling different sized materials to be held simultaneously at a perfect 90° angle, ensuring accurate joints for frames, boxes, and cabinets. An ergonomic ABS plastic handle provides comfortable operation. The clamp can also serve effectively as a drill press vice for added versatility on the job site or in the workshop.
